response.sql: WITH product_volume AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(30,10))) AS volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, volume, volume / NULLIF(SUM(volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volume), compared AS (SELECT volume, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

assumptions.assumption: Order volume means the sum of product_quantity, whose non-NULL values are numeric; the average covers products appearing in Order_Items.

alternatives.interpretation: Order volume means the number of order-item rows per product, regardless of quantity.
